finding.summary: The retry loop uses `time.sleep` (via `_sleep = time.sleep`) which blocks the calling thread. If LangChainLLM.chat is ever called from an async context (e.g., via ainvoke or in an async handler), this will block the event loop.
finding.fix: Use `asyncio.sleep` when in an async context, or document that this class is sync-only. Since the codebase appears sync-only currently, add a comment warning against async use.
